name: Majokko a la Mode Majo no Natsuyasumi
original_name: 魔女っ娘ア・ラ・モード まじょの夏休み
source:
Short story takes place after the events of the original game.
First morning of the summer vacations after the tiresome exam. New heroine Leylis appears in the bed of the protagonist. She slips away as he rubs his eyes. What's her true identity and intentions?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
